description: This PHP class 'CalendarDisplay' manages the rendering and interaction logic for the calendar component in SuiteCRM, including display functions, header/footer generation, and activity color management.

classes.name: CalendarDisplay
classes.description: Main class for rendering calendar views and managing interactions in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: checkActivity
methods.description: Merges user-specific activity color preferences with default activity colors and updates label names.

methods.name: load_settings_template
methods.description: Loads and assigns calendar settings template variables for the configuration popup.

methods.name: get_date_info
methods.description: Generates a string with date information based on the current view and date.

methods.name: get_next_calendar
methods.description: Returns HTML link to the next calendar view date range.

methods.name: get_previous_calendar
methods.description: Returns HTML link to the previous calendar view date range.

methods.name: display_calendar_header
methods.description: Outputs the header section of the calendar with navigation and controls.

methods.name: display_calendar_footer
methods.description: Outputs the footer section of the calendar.

methods.name: convertPHPToMomentFormat
methods.description: Converts PHP date format strings to Moment.js compatible format strings.

methods.name: display_title
methods.description: Outputs the title section of the calendar interface.

methods.name: display_shared_html
methods.description: Outputs HTML for shared calendar views, including user options and sort icons.
